label: Claude GitHub App
gloss: The Claude GitHub App's installation, which a cloud session's git proxy and its GitHub tools write through, on the repositories granted to it.

label: Your git credential
gloss: What git signs in with on the home laptop, shared by you and every agent there; an assistant's commit trailer is what tells their commits apart.

label: The app's stored token
gloss: The GitHub token the Web Tools app keeps in the browser it runs in; each browser holds its own.

label: Your GitHub login
gloss: Your signed-in session on github.com, which its file editor and pull request page write with.

label: Registry write token
gloss: A repository secret, a fine-grained token selecting web-tools-private alone, that the activity-cache and scheduled-tasks workflows write its state with.

label: Workflow token
gloss: The token GitHub hands each workflow run for its own repository, which the fetch workflows commit their snapshots with.

label: Log-Repo's token
gloss: The GitHub token stored on the phone that the Log-Repo shortcut writes run logs with.
